'''''Rahien''''' can refer to the followin:

* [[Rahien Demain]] - a [[Kandori]] [[Nobility|noble]] born at the end of the [[Aiel War]].
* ''[[Rahien Sorei]]'' - an [[Aiel warrior society]] whose name means "Dawn Runners" in the [[Old Tongue]].
* ''rahien'' - meaning "dawn" in the Old Tongue.
